caption_L1: Poverty rate for families in the United States from 1990 to 2019 is a line chart. The y-axis plots Poverty rate while the x-axis plots Year.
caption_L2L3: Poverty in the USA was at its highest in the early nineties, dropping in 2000 to its second lowest point on the chart.  Then poverty rose gradually again, almost hitting the same peak in 2010 and staying level for a few years before dropping sharply in the mid 2000's to well below the levels of the 90s.
